title.narrative: ILF for WASH Foundational Support (IMM & IR) for Maji Milele Limited

description.narrative: Scale - TA for Impact-Linked Finance for WASH (ILF for WASH)

The **Foundational Support Programme** is one of the [++technical assistance++](https://aquaforall.org/ilf-for-wash/ilf-for-wash-technical-assistance/) tracks available for impact-driven WASH enterprises, as part of the Impact-Linked Fund for Water, Sanitation and Hygiene ([++ILF for WASH++](https://aquaforall.org/ilf-for-wash/)). The programme is supported by the [++Social Finance Academy,++](https://social-finance-academy.org/) an initiative by Roots of Impact.
The programme aims to transfer knowledge and skills from certified service providers to WASH enterprises in two areas: **impact measurement and management (IMM)** and **investment readiness (IR)**. At the same time, the goal is to embed these areas into the specific business model of the selected enterprises.
One of the selected enterprises receiving support on both IMM and IR is Maji Milele Limited (hereinafter referred to as ‘Maji Milele’). Maji Milele provides a range of water management products and services to help boost revenue collection and efficiency. The company installs prepaid water meters and online monitoring software to track water distribution, consumption and payments. The enterprise also provides full-service infrastructure maintenance, revenue collection from users and water consumption monitoring.

title.narrative: Enterprise is able to systematically collect, monitor, analyse and report on impact (data).

description.narrative: Enterprise has developed an internal IMM system, i.e. i) impact strategy/Theory of Change, ii) data collection strategy/process/templates, iii) data collection and monitoring system, iv) impact/decision-making report template. Hence, the enterprise is fully prepared for the next phase (beyond the scope of this TA project), i.e. to operationalise the IMM system by developing surveys, collecting baseline (impact) data, periodically update these data, create impact reports and use them to steer operational decision-making.

comment.narrative: Maji Milele is more advanced commercially (compared to average enterprise applying for the programme) and very much impact-focused. The enterprise already achieves quite some impact, yet without being able to systematically demonstrate it. They collect quite a lot of data (but output-focused only) and have a few data points, but do not use it for performance/impact measurement and subsequent decision-making. A solid IMM system will greatly benefit the enterprise to define the enterprise’s overall impact statement/model as well as per business line, structure data and inform decision-making. A structured IMM approach will enable the enterprise to demonstrate impact and enhance their investment proposition.

actual.value: All deliverables related to setting up an Impact Measurement and Management (IMM) system/process have been successfully completed, i.e.: 1) Description of problem, solutions, revenue model; 2) Impact Model and Impact Statement; 3) Customer Promise Sheet; 4) Comprehensive Theory of Change; 5) Customer Touchpoint Journey; 6) Data Collection Plan; 7) Data Analysis and Review System; 8) Decision-Making Report. The next phase (beyond the scope of this TA project) is to operationalise the IMM system, e.g. development of surveys, collection of actual data and data analysis.

title.narrative: Enterprise is fully prepared to start raising (repayable) funding

description.narrative: Enterprise has all documents in place that are required for fundraising (e.g. pitch decks, terms sheet) and a data room available for when funders request information. Hence, the enterprise is fully prepared for the next phase (beyond the scope of this TA project), i.e. to raise (repayable) investment, demonstrated by a signed terms sheet, Expression of Interest (EoI) or actual funding/investment agreement.

comment.narrative: One of the main barriers perceived by the enterprise is lack of capital to grow their role as service provider, particularly to scale to other counties (within Kenya). When being able to scale/expand geographically, the enterprise can increase impact. There has been modest successful fundraising, but the IR support of the ILF for WASH Foundational Support Programme will greatly benefit the enterprise by means of, among others, support to create basic documents like a proper pitch deck (not available yet), review existing documents (e.g. investor memorandum), review financial model, check the feasibility of investment target, advisory on instruments and terms sheet, etc. Given the enterprise’s search for funders as well as co-investment opportunities, the service provider will also focus on creating a structured investor/funder hitlist + facilitate introductions.

actual.value: All deliverables related to Investment Readiness (IR) have been successfully completed, i.e.: 1) Pitch Deck; 2) Investor Valuation Memorandum; 3) Financial Model; 4) Financial Instrument Advisory; 5) Investor hitlist and Introductions; 6) Priced Round Term Sheet; 7) Investor Data Room; 8) Periodic Business Report; 9) Growth Metrics; 10) Recommendation Report. The next phase (beyond the scope of this TA project) is to raise (repayable) investment, demonstrated by a signed terms sheet, Expression of Interest (EoI) or actual funding/investment agreement.
